card.name: Drug interaction section wording
card.fires_on: Words inside drug-interaction text, such as partway through enzyme names (CYP3A4, UGT), 'between' after 'interactions', and 'co-administered'. It also fires on a few mid-word spots in toxicology text.

modes.label: Enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through CYP or UGT enzyme names in interaction statements.
modes.example: Concomitant use of strong<< C>>YP 3A4 inducers decreases

modes.label: Interaction phrasing
modes.description: Linking or verb words in statements about interactions or interaction studies.
modes.example: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS There are no known significant interactions<< between>> Anticoagulant Citrate Dext

modes.label: Partway through long words
modes.description: Middle of words like co-administered or mutagenicity in label text.
modes.example: Bacterial and mammalian mutagen<<icity>> studies using carbamazepine produced

card.writes: It pushes down 'unknown' and 'anonymous' style words and pushes up customer words, which gives no useful medical effect.
card.plain: It lights up in drug-interaction passages, especially inside enzyme names like CYP3A4 and in words like co-administered.
